description: Commit the current session's changes only, gateway-inline. Session-isolated (never -A, staged set verified against the session list), doc-sync-gated. The gateway runs the commit inline — it already holds the diff, session file list, and change intent; on a mechanical gate hit it judges doc-sync warm in its own context (the cold doc-sync-scan agent dispatches only past the scope ceiling), and the premise-closure judge dispatches on a product-anchor hit. Conventional message, commits directly, offers push on explicit confirmation. Bundled with super-bootstrap — encodes the harness commit rules.
